reviews.x: I ordered these headbands for my little girl to wear for her newborn photos. The shipping was very slow and the head bands come thrown all together in one package. The problem with packing the head bands that way is that it bends the material out of shape. Some of the flowers on the head bands looked great and others were horrible. For example, the fabric would be layered thick and nicely on one side and then almost no fabric on the other side. On the red flower it looked as though some of the f

These are the cutest headbands ever, but unfortunately they aren't all put together very nicely. One of them is not even wearable because the seam is showing. Some if the gems are off center and the fabric doesn't match the headbands perfectly on all of them. I also agree with everyone else that they are small and they do leave marks. The unique design and price are what makes me not regret the purchase. Delivery was fast. The third picture shows the actual colors best.

I was surprised at the cost of all these headbands and assumed they would be mediocre quality, but I was glad to be wrong. These headbands are super cute and great quality. The picture does them no justice. The centers are very pretty jeweled pieces and the material is perfect. I have seen similar if not exact headbands elsewhere for 3X the amount. I would buy more of these in different styles and from this seller. Shipping was quick.
Very cute and great quality for the price! Fit infant head perfectly woth room to grow. Also fit on toddlers head.

reviews.t: Great Product with Excellent Customer Service
reviews.x: I had been eyeing these for a while for my 1 year old. I finally decided she HAD to have them and I'm so glad I purchased them. The perfect colors to have on hand for her various outfits. Two of the flowers were obviously not up to standard with the rest of them, so I contacted the seller and they sent me replacements with a free gift as an apology. They are well made and darling. Love them!

I purchased these headbands for my daughters, 4 and 1. I was very pleased with the quality. They are amazing. Very very pretty. They work best on my oldest daughter as she has longer hair and they stay put. They tend to slip off of my 1 year old as she has very short hair. I would highly recommend these headbands to anyone!

These were SO cute!! My baby girl hasn't even been born yet, but I know she'll be wearing these in all of her pictures when we announce her to the world! Seem to be good quality, they are small enough of a flower not to overpower her, and I love the rhinestones! Received sooner than expected.

These headbands are gorgeous. My only issue is that after just a month and a half (she is 4 months now) they are beginning to fit snugly and leaving a mark on my daughter's head. I'm not sure how much more wear we can get out of them.
Would reccomend these to everyone, exactly as described.  Perfect for newborns and young babies.  My 5 month old has been wearing them since she was born and the colors and fit are great!
Overall the head ands are cute but mine did not include the middle parts. The headband is also different colors than the flower!
Fits 3 month old (with big head😊) really well! Also very chic looking. Great bows! Great assortment of colors, too.

reviews.t: Great gift and sweet romantic color scheme.
reviews.x: Well, my lovely 8 month old has a large head. Its very adorable, but large. This has actually been confirmed by our doctor who then measured our heads and said it was genetic. :)  That being said, we have a hard time finding bows that actually fit her.  These are just now starting to get a bit tight and causing some indent marks. The colors are really wonderful and go with just about everything. We get a lot of complements on her bows. With her light hair, I will say that the black one tends to

These headbands are really cute and are of good quality. Unfortunately, the headbands are pretty tight and leave quite the dent in her little 3 month old head (her head measures about the average size for a 3 month old). It doesn't seem to bug her, but I don't like the unsightly pink dent going around her little head. You also have to be extra careful when putting them on to make sure they don't flick because they are made out of stretchy elastic.  Update: as my baby grew more hair I used these

I love these one on my baby girl. She's worn them sense she was new born. They're very durable. I have them in a drawer in my bathroom, stuff them in the diaper bag ect and they still look brand new! When she was first born they were a little big but I just tied a little knot in them so they would fit. As her head got bigger I took the knot out. She's now 6 months (August 2013) and they still fit her great. They also fit my 2 year old. Highly recommended! I would be sad if I even lost 1 lol :)

reviews.t: Great price and a little different.
reviews.x: I bought these for my eight-month-old and they fit her just fine I think they'll still fit her when she's a toddler. They are so pretty on and have already received tons of compliments. They are not overstated or oversized huge bows which is a nice change from what I find in the stores. It is  nice to have the variety of colors as they go with so many outfits. Great price !

I love these have the various colors. Usually you see a lot of just pink, but this has other colors that go with any outfit you can think of! They do fit a little tight on my 3 month old’s head, and she’s average size, 75th percentile for head circumference. Other than not lasting her too long, very cute while she can wear them and a good price for how many you get.

A great price and we get compliments everywhere we go. I was worried that they would be too dressy for every day where but they are perfect. Who doesn't need a little glitz in their wardrobe? My LO is 4 months and wearing these and my 2 y/o niece wears them too. Great to have something in every color. Just wish they had a purple one.

Super cute bows, perfect for pictures. You could see some glue on a couple, but easily removed. Amazing for the price, these would be $4+ a piece on Etsy.  I was a little bummed when I got them and it did not include the navy bow (pictured), but then I counted the bows I realized I received 12 bows, bonus! Definitely worth it.

These headbands are beautiful. For this price, you can't pass them up. My daughter is now 7 months and these particular ema Jane headbands do leave a mark around her head, but they don't seem overly tight. I'll turn them into hair clips so I can use them as she grows

I had to give 5 stars because of the great quality. They're adorable, you get lots of different colors and the price is great! I should also mention they don't fit too loose or tight on my baby's head so she doesn't fuss about wearing them. Thanks!

These are adorable, fit my 18 month old perfectly, and are so pretty! I love the flowers and jewels, they are not too big, just he right size for her head. You cannot beat the price, I would get these again for sure!

Headbands are so pretty. Especially the jewel in the center! The only complaint I have is that one of the headband's flower and band don't match (band is light purple and flower is pinkish). Overall a great purchase!

These headbands are exactly what I was looking for . I wanted something not too dramatic yet still girly for my daughter and these are perfect . Jewels look very nice and exactly what the picture looks like .
Have used these since my daughter was born when they grow just stretch the band and it fits perfectly. People on etsy resell this product for triple so make sure you buy from here or ema Jane website
Great quality, adorable, beautiful colors. I have it 3 stars because it says it fits all ages but they are a little tight on my 2 1/2 year old but would be great for a baby or newborn. Fast shipping!

claims.text: Most reviewers find the headbands very cute and of good quality for the price.
A few reviewers report defective or poorly assembled headbands, such as visible seams, off-center gems, or missing middle pieces.
Some reviewers say the headbands run tight and leave marks on the baby's head, especially as the baby grows.
Several reviewers praise the fit for newborns and infants, with some noting room to grow or a good fit for larger heads.
A couple of reviewers mention slow shipping or packaging that bent the headbands out of shape.
